name: Fog of Doom Lets Every Heathen Listen
description: **Needs the Fog of Doom God Power** (400 Divine Energy). While the Fog of Doom's thick fog is over the island, you can drop a believer of 14 or more on a Heathen in an orange or red mask, and they listen just as a blue-masked Heathen does: the believer is "Explaining the truth", and when the believer's Devotion check passes the Heathen is "Listening" and their Faith rises by 3 (4 at Devotion 50 or more, 5 at 88 or more); then they cannot be preached to for 2 real-life hours, as in the normal game. **Only a Heathen whose Faith is below -10 listens.** **From Faith -10 up, only the Earthquake God Power reaches them** (as in the normal game, it raises every Heathen's Faith by 2 to 8). The first time one of a village's Heathens turns a drop away for this, a popup (in the game's own popup window with its OK, no title) says "The fog hides you, but <name> still won't listen. Something stronger may stir them." (with Guardians of Isola Rewrite: "... <name> is still wary. Perhaps another approach may convince them."): once per village, never again there even after quitting, until Start Over begins a new village. **Needs Story / Cheat Upgrades (on by default) for the popup: that patch's DLL shows it, when no other popup or island event is showing or on its way.** A Heathen joins the tribe the normal game's way, when their Faith rises above 0. **Only the Fog of Doom God Power counts: natural fog, a Tempest and every other weather do nothing.** Blue-masked Heathens, the Heathen Doctor, the Chief, the three Masters and the Mommy are unchanged. **Works the same with every other patch and in every population mode.** **Not yet seen in a running game** (checked by emulation of the stock executable). The companion is "VVFP Fog Listening.dll"; it never writes a save, only one small file in the save's own patcher folder that marks the message as shown.
behavior_changes: The drop handler 0x443BF0: an adult (age 280 age units or more) dropped on a Heathen (+0x1CEC) who is not the Heathen Doctor (role 12) and wears the orange (+0x1CED) or red (+0x1CEE) mask, which the stock game turns away at 0x44402D, is given the stock blue-mask path 0x443D65 -- the Heathen action 6 ("Waiting for someone"), the dropped villager action 0x27 ("Explaining the truth") -- when the weather 0x710948's thick-fog test 0x476260 answers yes (fog on, +0x500C, and thickness +0x5010 at least 2: only the Fog of Doom God Power, 0x41FB60, sets it to 4; every fog starts at 1, 0x475EDC) and the Heathen's Faith (+0x1CF0) is below -10.

The sermon's end is the stock work event 0x468DA0, unchanged: roles 12-17 refuse, the 2-hour wait (+0x1CF4) refuses, the preacher's Devotion check 0x46B270(5); on success the Heathen's action 0x29 ("Listening"), the wait set, Faith +3 (+1 at Devotion 50, +1 more at 88) through 0x468020, and the Faith setter 0x467F90's own conversion 0x4668B0 above 0.

The notice: when the thick-fog test answers yes and the Faith limit turns an orange or red Heathen away (without vv5_fog_of_doom_no_restrictions), no notice is waiting, and the slot's file "Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher\Save <S>\Data\Fog of Doom\Fog of Doom Notice - Save <S>.dat" (native/shared/per_save_data.h; the slot from the save manager [0x4DACE0]+0x17D80) is not there, a notice is kept waiting with the Heathen's whole name (+0x1B9C, long_name.h). "VVFP Story Upgrades.dll" (story_fog_notice.inc) asks VvfpFogNoticePending every frame and shows it as Popup When Believers Become Heathens' popup is shown (story_notice_arm: the island-event notice, armed only when the event slot is free and the game's trigger shows it at once; not counted, not logged, the next island event keeps its time), with no title (an empty title string; New Believers draws the title apart from the text), with the owner's words through VVFP Translations.dll (the Guardians of Isola words when the game's string 0x48 says "left the tribe"); once armed, VvfpFogNoticeTaken makes the file. Start Over deletes the save's folder (native/shared/save_reset.c) and VvfpStoryVillageReset drops a waiting notice (VvfpFogNoticeVillageReset), so a new village is told again; a waiting notice of another slot is dropped.

needs_on.for: the popup, which that patch's DLL shows (without it the drop is still turned away, with no popup)

explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion splices the one site at run time, only after verifying its stock bytes; registers and flags are as they were at both places it goes on.

The Earthquake God Power (0x41F6E0) is unchanged: it already raises every living villager's Faith by 2 to 8 but the six special roles, Heathens of every mask included (0x41F79F), so from Faith -10 up it is the one way left to a Heathen in the orange or red mask.
Blue-masked Heathens, the drop's other branches, the work event's odds, Faith and wait, the conversion, logs, last names, masks and statistics are the game's own (and the other patches' own).
Nothing is written to a save or a villager record; the one file is the notice's mark.

runtime_detours.routine: the drop handler 0x443BF0's mask test (an adult dropped on a Heathen who is not the Heathen Doctor): `cmp byte [esi+0x1CED], bl / jne 0x44402D / cmp byte [esi+0x1CEE], bl / jne 0x44402D`. A Heathen in neither mask goes on at 0x443D65 as before; one in the orange or red mask goes on at 0x443D65 (the stock listening path) when the game's thick-fog test 0x476260 on the weather 0x710948 answers yes and the Heathen's Faith (+0x1CF0) is below -10, else at 0x44402D (the stock end of the drop)
runtime_detours.installed_by: VVFP Fog Listening.dll, VvfpStartup (started by VVFP More Companions.dll, third word)
